Resolves #21744

Aligns `Neo.form.field.Select`'s outer vertical margins (`5px 0`), top label (`0 0 3px`, `--selectfield-label-color`), and closed `<select>` chrome (`27px` border-box height, `28px` in `cyberpunk`, shared field surface/border/radius/typography, placeholder color, and hover/focus/invalid/disabled states) with sibling `TextField` and `ComboBox` across all five shipped themes. Under `@supports (appearance: base-select)` + `.neo-selectfield-customizable`, adds a `22px` ComboBox-style right trigger segment (`1px` divider + CSS border-built chevron on `::picker-icon` with zero icon-font dependency) and themes the open `::picker(select)` surface, border, elevation shadow, options, checkmark, and selected/disabled states while keeping classic `customizable: false` on a single native OS arrow.

Evidence: L3 (5-theme Whitebox E2E without FontAwesome + `1440 × 900` and 2× DPR dialog/picker frames in `neo-dark` and `neo-light`) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-4).

Related: #6136, #20874

## Deltas from ticket

- Every `--selectfield-*` value resolves from literals or each theme's own `Global.css` (`check-theme-value-files`, `check-theme-var-references`, and `check-theme-coverage` green), so standalone `SelectField` pages that do not load `Text.css`, `Picker.css`, `trigger/Base.css`, or `list/Base.css` still receive the full palette.
- Also resolves `@neo-opus-grace`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:74b0355f`) on `SelectField` vs top-labeled `TextField` height, top-margin, and fill alignment.

Frame critique: In `EventEditor`, `Resource` (`SelectField`) matches `Title`, `Start`, `End`, and `Progress (%)` in `27px` control height, `#11141C` / `#FFFFFF` fill, `#253974` / `#DDDDDD` border, `#D3D6DF` / `#666666` label color, and right trigger divider alignment (`x = 900` collinear with the `Start` and `End` `TimeField` triggers), and its open `::picker(select)` adopts the active theme's surface, border, shadow, option text, and selected row. Two visible items stay out of scope: `EventEditor`'s text/date/number fields use `labelPosition: 'left'` while `Resource` uses a top label (explicitly out of scope on #21744), and in the dimmed background Scheduler header `.neo-timeline-now` crosses the `12:00` minor tick label (noted in `defect-note` `MESSAGE:06c8c743`; header bottom-edge seam fixed in #21772).

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge (polish, dead code):**
  - These two rules in `Select.css` never match: `&.neo-hovered:not(.neo-focus, .neo-disabled) .neo-selectfield-input` and `&.neo-focus:not(.neo-disabled) .neo-selectfield-input`.
  - Only `Neo.form.field.Text` writes those classes: `onFocusEnter`/`onFocusLeave` for `neo-focus`, and `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` for `neo-hovered`. A search of `src` at `dev` `7cd0d6618e` finds no other writer apart from the calendar's own event nodes.
  - `Select` extends `Neo.form.field.Base`, so the input's `:hover` and `:focus` rules carry those states; that is why the focus-parity assertion passes.
  - Drop the two rules on your next push. They don't justify a push of their own.
- **Challenge (watch item):** the test pins the closed field to TextField, but nothing pins the copies beside it.

  - In the dark themes, the picker assertions (`not white`, `not black`) prove only that the browser default is gone, not that the theme's tokens apply.
